style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio paper only: porcelain paper sweep #FBF7F2 for the hung packshot, the three-cell detail board, the rear silhouette screen and the variant rail; chalk rose cove #F7DCE6 swept wall to floor for the benefit poster, the worn scene, the twin comparison panels and the spec panel; one saturated chartreuse board #CBE04A for the closing screen only; the shell's own sheer face meeting an unstained birch ply edge #E9E2D6 for the single weave macro; one mulberry hairline rule #3E2A34 under every section masthead; never a gradient, never a real outdoor street, railway, glasshouse, seaside or playground scene and never a hue outside this list
style.direction: bright studio childrenswear outer-layer commerce, sheer-shell translucency held on a chalk rose cove with one acid chartreuse pop and strict infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: single-weight pictograms knocked out of solid chartreuse disc tiles #CBE04A, index cells drawn as rounded-square blank tab slots with their numeral frames left empty, one hairline mulberry rule #3E2A34 as the only divider; no circular index chips, no hexagons, no diamonds, no bevel-cut squares, no magnifier inset windows, no seal outlines, no certificate artwork
style.lightingSystem: neutral daylight-balanced softbox key around 5000K placed at the upper right of every screen, a black-flag negative fill on the shadow side so the sheer shell reads translucent instead of blown out, one crisp narrow contact shadow under every hem and folded edge, matched light on both panels of any split screen, no warm cast, no cool cast, no rim glow, raking skim light reserved for the single weave macro
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright studio childrenswear outer-layer visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of porcelain paper #FBF7F2, chalk rose studio cove #F7DCE6, citrus chartreuse accent #CBE04A and mulberry ink #3E2A34, with unstained birch ply #E9E2D6 as the only sanctioned prop material; neutral daylight-balanced softbox key around 5000K placed at the upper right with a black-flag negative fill on the shadow side and one crisp narrow contact shadow under every hem; seamless studio paper only, no outdoor scenery; one modern geometric sans-serif across Chinese and Latin labels with each section masthead stacked as a Latin kicker over a Chinese title plus one boxed sub-tag; single-weight pictograms knocked out of solid chartreuse disc tiles and rounded-square blank tab slots as the only icon language; stable garment scale, the shell hung on a birch dowel rail or worn by a generic child cropped from the chin up or seen from behind; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no identifiable child face, no readable lettering, numerals or year marks.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hue beyond chartreuse #CBE04A plus the sanctioned birch ply prop tone #E9E2D6
no mixed fonts, no script, no brush lettering and no handwritten or retro lettering
no random backgrounds and no outdoor street, railway, glasshouse, seaside or playground scenery
no inconsistent lighting, no warm or cool cast drift and no blown-out sheer fabric
no identifiable child face, no readable lettering, numerals or year marks
style.presentationRules: keep one garment scale and one settled hang across the set so the shell reads as the same object; the shell is shown hung on the dowel rail or worn by a generic child body cropped from the chin up or turned away with the head outside the frame; front placket state is stated per screen and never mixed inside one panel; every printed or patched area stays a blank placement zone whose artwork is carried only by the reference photo
style.surfaceSystem: unstained birch ply rail, dowel and low step blocks #E9E2D6 as the only physical furniture, matte porcelain paper #FBF7F2 beneath laid cells and cards, chalk rose paper cove #F7DCE6 as the worn-scene floor, garment faces stay flat, lint-free and unwrinkled with no debris in frame
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label; each section masthead stacks a Latin kicker line over a Chinese section title with one boxed sub-tag pinned at a fixed left margin; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-40pt, subline 15pt, label 11-13pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; no script, handwritten, brush, retro or outline faces and no readable numerals, letters or year marks anywhere outside the bracketed slots
